list.text: Cerulean City Pokemon Gym Leader: Misty\nThe Tomboyish Mermaid
Trendsetter of the Bicycle Boom\nCerulean Bike Main Shop
My Slowbro and I make an awesome combination!
Slowbro is full of the fighting spirit!
I'm a huge fan of Cerulean Gym's Misty.
The cape in the north is a good place for dates.
Just between you and me...\nMisty, the Gym Leader, is sometimes there at the cape.
Guess I don't stand a chance!
You're collecting every single kind of Pokemon?
That must be quite a challenge, but it sounds fun, too.
